content: Outline for “The Fallen” Marcus  Marcus falls to earth confused  He spends many days wandering the forest  He sees no sign of humanity  Searching for the bunkers he finds them completely gone Eventually he finds another pod, but it is ancient  He is attacked by wolves and loses his supplies and AI  He finds a trail and sees horses  He ends up at  Orah’s  house.  Corliss Corliss is a warden we find her hunting a fugitive  She catches him and is called back to the keep  During their travels we find out as she explains to her apprentice We learn about the senpai, the wardens, the keep and the land  Upon returning to the keep we learn about the keep and Uri  She is sent for by her estranged father Rogan
